player_identity.theta_key: Exact player name string from parsed .phh files (case-sensitive).
player_identity.cross_session: The same string in different session folders denotes the same θ; a roster name that only appears in session A never receives updates from session B.
player_identity.isolation: Each entry in ``players`` is fit in a separate EM loop. Updating one name does not change tensors or JSON fields for any other name.

notes.preflop_em: theta_pre tilts population logits from train.py beta_preflop.
notes.postflop_em: theta_post tilts population logits from train.py beta_facing / beta_no_bet.
